# Domain Agent Map

## All 6 Domains with Specialist Agents

### Finance Domain

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    CFO[Chief Financial Officer]
    
    subgraph Finance["Finance Domain Agents"]
        IS[Investment Strategist]
        FP[Financial Planner]
        RG[Risk Governor]
        PA[Portfolio Architect]
        MA[Macro Analyst]
        OI[Options Intelligence]
    end
    
    CFO --> IS
    CFO --> FP
    CFO --> RG
    CFO --> PA
    CFO --> MA
    CFO --> OI
    
    style CFO fill:#48dbfb,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    style Finance fill:#c8d6e5,stroke:#333
```

## Agent Role Summary

| Role Type | Description | Count Across System |
|-----------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Strategist** | Generate plans, recommendations | ~30 |
| **Observer** | Detect patterns, signals | ~6 |
| **Governor** | Enforce safety, limits, alignment | 6 |
